WHY IT IS HARD

What Makes Manufacturing ERP Difficult to Implement Across Production Operations?

A manufacturing ERP touches every department at once, and each one keeps its own version of the truth today. Projects stall when BoMs, stock and shop-floor reporting are not fixed together. Pick an area of the factory to see where it usually breaks.

                DATA MIGRATION

                How Does Unisas Handle Manufacturing Data Migration?

                BoMs are where migrations fail: codes that don't match, units written three ways, work centres that changed names. We load in a fixed order and test every file before it goes in. Try it with a BoM export from Excel.
